subject.title: feat(android): pair multiple gateways and switch between them without re-pairing

question: Should maintainers continue sponsoring this Android multi-gateway PR as the landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100700 after the TLS fix, rebase, proof, and security review, or should the work be split into a narrower staged Android implementation?
rationale: The feature changes official Android mobile UX plus credential, TLS-trust, notification, chat, and voice/session ownership, so automation can identify blockers but cannot choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Proceed After Fix And Proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the Android candidate, require the saved-manual TLS fix, mergeable rebase, real Android proof, and security-owner review before landing.

options.title: Stage A Narrower Android Slice
options.body: Ask for a smaller Android sequence that lands registry, credential migration, and UI/state isolation in separate reviewable steps tied to the canonical issue.

options.title: Pause This PR
options.body: Defer this branch if maintainers want the merged iOS shape or broader mobile design to bake before Android adopts the same state model.

recommendation.title: Proceed After Fix And Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the Android candidate, require the saved-manual TLS fix, mergeable rebase, real Android proof, and security-owner review before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the linked feature direction and current Android/iOS implementation history most directly.
